purpose: Curated subset of dataset.json used by CI tier 1 (non-llm-infrastructure-sample) and tier 3 (llm-providers-sample). See docs/benchmark-smoke-set.md for selection criteria and update procedure.

rows.rationale: Supported verdict on a stable live HTML source (cis.org immigration report). Exercises the live-fetch + LLM-verdict path for the most common verdict class.
Supported verdict on a PDF source (census.gov via Wayback). Exercises the PDF extraction path (unpdf) — the only fetch path that differs structurally from HTML.
Partially supported verdict on a Wayback Machine archive URL (web.archive.org). Exercises the archive-fetch path including Wayback preamble stripping in the proxy.
Not supported verdict on a live HTML source (Sydney Morning Herald). Exercises the verdict path where the source contradicts or fails to support the claim.
